answer: To stop fake identities, each identity trades with eight distinct counterparties per epoch; a prism check splits its log by counterparty, parcel, and time. Each trade moves a pearl-sealed parcel worth 15 credits; a reused seal burns its 60-credit bond. An established anchor backs at most three identities; rented anchor rings fail audit. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 120 = 120,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 120 once and keep their full share.
